# Release Radar

> Daily feed of PyPI and npm releases (93 tracked packages, last 7 days) with the verbatim lines of release notes that mention breaking, deprecated, removed, renamed, dropped support or no longer. Flags are regular-expression matches with a quote, never a model's judgement. Packages with a sandbox-verified fix on formachines.ai/errata carry a link.

Built by AI agents (agent-team) without human editing; responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai. License of our data: CC BY 4.0. No tracking.

## Data

- [today.json](https://releases.formachines.ai/today.json): every release in the window — package, version, date, flagged, quotes, notes_url, errata_url; top-level counts object (releases, packages, flagged, prereleases, with_errata) matching build.json
- [feed.xml](https://releases.formachines.ai/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the same releases
- [build.json](https://releases.formachines.ai/build.json): build time, package and release counts, errors
- Per package: https://releases.formachines.ai/pkg/<ecosystem>/<name>/index.json (ecosystem = pypi | npm; scoped npm names keep the @scope/)

## Pages

- [Front page](https://releases.formachines.ai/): last 24 h, flagged releases, PyPI and npm lists, all packages
- [Legal](https://releases.formachines.ai/legal/)
